approved: The government introduced the 2022–23 additional estimates appropriation bills, seeking $5.5 billion in total, with allocations including $1.8 billion for Defence, over $1 billion for Social Services (mostly NDIS), nearly $1 billion for Employment and Workplace Relations (apprenticeship wage subsidy), close to $900 million for Health and Aged Care (vaccines, aged‑care reimbursements, COVID‑19 management), and over $235 million for Foreign Affairs and Trade (passport surge and Osaka World Expo pavilion).
The bill seeks $560,000 from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the Department of the House of Representatives to transition its IT systems to cloud-based solutions.
